_about: A copy of creaite v2.6.11 (1c192ce) edit_ai.py OPTIONS, PLACES, FORMATS and stores/aiEdit.js AI_GROUPS, for the parity test only. Read from the tag; no creaite path is read at test time.

rewrite.name: Rewrite clearly
rewrite.line: The same points, in plainer words
rewrite.instruction: Rewrite the text so it reads clearly: plain words, short sentences, the same points in the same order.

shorter.name: Shorter
shorter.line: About half the length; the facts kept
shorter.instruction: Make the text shorter, about half its length. Keep every date, number, name and item ID that matters.

longer.name: Longer
longer.instruction: Make the text a little longer and fuller, so each point is explained. Add no facts: no new dates, numbers, names, items or claims that the text doesn't already hold.

executive.name: Make it executive
executive.line: The executive voice: the position and what matters first
executive.instruction: Rewrite the text in the executive voice below: bottom line first, quantified, names and dates, outcomes before activities. Keep its facts and add none.

format.name: Add headings and bold
format.line: Sub-headings, lists and bold where they help
format.instruction: Format the text so it is easy to scan: short paragraphs, bulleted or numbered lists and sub-headings where they help, bold for the few key words. Keep the words themselves.

checklist.name: Pull out the tasks
checklist.line: Finds the tasks and writes one a line to tick off
checklist.instruction: Turn the text into a checklist: one task a line, each starting with a verb, written as Markdown task items ("- [ ] "). Keep the owner and date with a task when the text gives them.

summary.name: Summarise at the top
summary.line: A short summary first; the text kept below it
summary.instruction: Write a two- or three-sentence summary of the text, as a paragraph that starts with "**Summary.**", then a blank line, then the text exactly as it was.

polish.name: Polish
polish.line: Spelling, grammar and a lighter touch on the wording; the facts and length kept
polish.instruction: Polish the text: correct spelling, grammar and punctuation in British English, and smooth awkward wording lightly. Keep its facts, its order, its length and its voice; add and remove nothing.

notes.name: Format notes
notes.line: Rough notes sorted under headings, with bullets; every point kept
notes.instruction: Format these rough notes: sort them under short headings with bullets beneath. Keep every point and every date, number, name and item ID; add nothing and drop nothing. If the text already has headings (a Working session note's template), keep those headings and file the points under them.

formal.name: More formal
formal.line: A more formal tone for the email
formal.instruction: Rewrite the text in a more formal, professional tone. Keep its facts and its length.

warmer.name: Warmer
warmer.line: A warmer, friendlier tone for the email
warmer.instruction: Rewrite the text in a warmer, friendlier tone, still professional. Keep its facts and its length.
